X.note: Dark scene with three glossy cubes, which is a decent look. The labels collide with the objects, and the 13% label is ghosted and overlaps its own cube and a connector line. 'ACTUAL' appears three times, as a badge on each label and again in the corner, which is redundant noise. The cubes aren't scaled to 7/6/13, so the 13% cube is the same size as the 6% one and the numbers carry no visual meaning. The grey-on-dark text for the 13% description is low contrast on a phone. The caption and source lines are large and fine.

Y.note: Terrain map with a clean look: soft relief, coin stack, document and gantry icons, and a glowing loop. The text is large and clean, with high-contrast chips. But the icons are tiny and the coins are unlabeled. The meaning of the loop, the four coins, the document and the crane is not clear without narration. The 'Wages 1 / Scale 1' chips say little. No place name is visible and the map region can't be identified. The flat green terrain is a little bland, and the caption is only mildly informative.

why: Y is cleaner and fully legible with no overlaps or broken elements, while X's number labels collide with the objects and one is ghosted and hard to read, even though X's numbers are more explicit.
top_fix_for_weaker: In X, separate the labels from the cubes and set their positions so none overlaps an object or another label. Put the 13% label in full-contrast text with its own space, drop the repeated ACTUAL badges (keep one at most), and scale the cube heights to 7/6/13 so the 3D objects show the quantity.
